title: toxocarpus lineatus
intro: Toxocarpus lineatus, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae, is a type of evergreen shrub native to tropical Africa. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, pain, and inflammation due to its anti-inflammatory and analgesic effects. The therapeutic actions of Toxocarpus lineatus include its ability to exhibit antiseptic, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, making it useful for wound healing and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified as alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
